     4	 * American Soundex of a surname: the first letter followed by three digits encoding the remaining

    14	    }

    16	    /** Soundex code (one letter + three digits) of {@code name}; "" when it has no letters. */
    17	    public static String encode(String name) {
    18	        String letters = name == null ? "" : name.toUpperCase().replaceAll("[^A-Z]", "");
    19	        if (letters.isEmpty()) {
    20	            return "";
    21	        }
    22	        StringBuilder code = new StringBuilder().append(letters.charAt(0));
    23	        char prev = codeOf(letters.charAt(0));
    24	        for (int i = 1; i < letters.length() && code.length() < 4; i++) {
    25	            char c = codeOf(letters.charAt(i));
    26	            if (c != '0' && c != prev) {

## Overview

This is the Spring PetClinic REST project converted to OfficeFloor function injection. All the concepts you listed live in one package: `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`. Values are computed by small static helper classes and by pipeline "function" classes wired in `owners.POST.yml`, then surfaced onto the `OwnerDto` via MapStruct expression mappings in `OwnerMapper`. Note: the `OwnerDto` itself is generated at build time from `openapi.yml` (there is no `OwnerDto.java` in `src`); the field definitions live in the OpenAPI schema.

## Key computation classes ("single source of truth")

### customerCode — `AssignCustomerCode.java`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignCustomerCode.java`

Computes `customerCode` as `<REGION>-<HASH8>`. HASH8 = first 8 **upper-case** hex chars of SHA-256 over `telephone + lastName`. Region comes from `OwnerLocality.forPostcode`.
- Lines 18-22: `service` sets `region + "-" + hash8(telephone + lastName)`.
- Lines 25-37: `hash8()` — SHA-256 via `MessageDigest`, first 4 bytes formatted `%02X`.

Note the class Javadoc (openapi example `FRA-0001`) describes an older `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` format; the actual code produces `<REGION>-<HASH8>` (e.g. `NSW-AB12CD34`).

### checkDigit / Luhn — `CustomerCodeCheckDigit.java`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/CustomerCodeCheckDigit.java`

The Luhn check digit over the digits in `customerCode`; non-digits ignored.
- Lines 12-28: `of(String customerCode)` — reverse iterate, double alternating digits, subtract 9 when >9, return `(10 - sum%10) % 10`.

### SHA-256 identity key — `OwnerIdentity.java`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerIdentity.java`

The `identityKey`: full lower-case hex SHA-256 of `telephone + "|" + email + "|" + Soundex(lastName)`.
- Lines 21-24: `key(Owner)`.
- Lines 27-39: `sha256Hex()` — `MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")`, `%02x` per byte.

(The openapi.yml description of `identityKey` is stale — it describes `normalizedTelephone|email|householdId`, but the code hashes telephone|email|soundex(lastName).)

### FiscalYear — `FiscalYear.java`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/FiscalYear.java`

Single source for fiscal year: starts 1 July, named by the calendar year it ends in.
- Lines 17-19: `of(LocalDate)` — `month >= 7 ? year+1 : year`.

### Region code / locality — `OwnerLocality.java`
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/OwnerLocality.java`

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The owner's optional honorific (e.g. MR/MRS/MS/DR); when present it prefixes the derived salutation."
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The flat postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward compatibility; when structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is preferred and 'address' is returned as the composed value. Supply either this or 'addressLine1'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: ".*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: "The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when present."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: ".*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: "The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address, appended after a single space to the composed 'address'."
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 5'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: ".*\\S.*"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when present it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode."
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when present it derives the read-only ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path to this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's assigned customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'.
              type: string
              example: 'FRA-0001'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the registration date.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registration date, formatted 'FY<YY>'.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same last name and address).
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email and householdId empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identityKey matches."
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name (case-insensitive) when it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners had already been created today (by registration date) when this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already held 40 to 49 owners (approaching the hard limit of 50) when this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when, at creation, an existing owner shared this owner's last name and postcode but had a different telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this one soft-matches on last name and postcode; absent when possibleDuplicate is false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "The owner's membership points: start at 0, add 2 when an email is present, add 1 when namesakeCount is 0, add 2 for a household of 3 or more, add 3 for tenure of one or more elapsed fiscal years."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level from 1 to 4, banded from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The owner's upper-cased initials, e.g. 'G.F.'.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation, formatted as 'title lastName' when a title is supplied, otherwise just the last name."
              type: string
              example: 'DR who'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's region derived from their city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' for any other city."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The owner's IANA timezone derived from their region (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane); absent for any other region."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "'EMAIL' when the owner has an email address, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': TIER is 'PREMIUM' at membershipLevel 3 or more else 'STANDARD'; AREA is 'METRO' for a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD) else 'REGIONAL'."
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band at their registration date, derived from birthDate: 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+); absent when birthDate is not supplied."
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:

              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: "True when the owner has been soft-deleted (the record is retained but excluded from duplicate/identity checks); false for a live owner."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

## Summary

I unified `customerCode` and `membershipNumber` into a single `memberId` formatted `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`, and removed the standalone `customerCode`, `membershipNumber`, and `checkDigit` DTO fields.

**How it works now:** the memberId is `region` + two-digit fiscal year + the 8 upper-hex SHA-256 of `telephone+lastName` + a Luhn check digit over `<REGION><FY><HASH8>`. Example from the run: `NSW` + `27` + `16E6609E` + `1` = `NSW2716E6609E1`.

**Structural-impact-minimizing choices:**
- Reused the existing `customer_code` column as internal storage for the memberId, so I left the large `Owner` entity, `schema.sql`, `data.sql`, and the `.POST.yml` pipeline wiring **untouched**.
- Collision handling (`DeduplicateCustomerCode`) and the check-digit helper (`CustomerCodeCheckDigit`) needed **no changes** — dedup already operates on the stored value, which is now the memberId, so collision handling applies to it automatically.
- Every function I changed is a small method in a small class (`AssignCustomerCode`, `OwnerLocality.region`, the mapper interface method, `AuditOwnerCreated.service`, `EmitOwnerCreatedEvent.service`), keeping WMC_other and per-method complexity low.

**Six files touched:**
1. `AssignCustomerCode` — builds the full memberId (region + FY + hash8 + check digit).
2. `OwnerLocality.region` — derives the region from the memberId's leading letter-run (no `-` split), so owner segment and locality still resolve.
3. `OwnerMapper` — dropped `membershipNumber`/`checkDigit` mappings, added `memberId`.
4. `AuditOwnerCreated` — logs `memberId` (removed the membershipNumber helper).
5. `EmitOwnerCreatedEvent` — emits `memberId` in the structured event.
6. `openapi.yml` — removed the three fields, added the `memberId` schema.

The fiscal-year value is embedded in the memberId via the shared `FiscalYear`, and the audit record and owner segment now reference the memberId.
